blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: With the development of applications like autonomous driving, object detection has gained significant attention, while also highlighting critical vulnerabilities like backdoor attacks that severely compromise model integrity. Specifically, such attacks involve altering the categories of objects ( i.e., object misclassification), removing bounding boxes ( i.e., object disappearance), or generating bounding box proposals for non-existent objects ( i.e., object generation) when a predefined trigger is present in the input. Although backdoor defenses for image classification are well-established, the research for object detection remains comparatively underexplored. Existing defenses address these threats by scanning outputs or models for potential backdoors but require discarding either malicious data or models. This remedy fails to enable a continuous and accurate perceptual stream for the object detection pipeline. To address such limitations, we propose ODPure, a novel input-stage black-box defense for object detection, which is based on input purification that ensures stable perception flows. Tailored to the dense prediction nature of object detectors, our Corruption-Reconstruction-Selection (CRS) paradigm operates by neutralizing triggers through a diverse portfolio of corruptions to generate a massive pool of redundant proposals, then recovering fine-grained structural cues via generative priors, and finally employing voting to reach a consensus on the resulting detections. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that our method provides robust defense against diverse backdoor attacks and trigger types while preserving baseline accuracy. Our code is available at https://github.com/Alex66366/ODPure .
blocks.zh: 随着自主驾驶等应用的发展,物体探测也获得了显著关注,同时也突出了后门攻击等严重危害模型完整性的关键弱点. 具体来说,这种攻击涉及改变对象的类别(即对象错误分类),去除边框(即对象消失),或者在输入中存在预先定义的触发时,为不存在对象(即对象生成)生成边框建议. 虽然对图像分类的后门防御已经确立,但是对物体探测的研究仍然相对未得到充分的探索. 现有防御手段通过扫描输出物或潜在后门模型来应对这些威胁,但需要放弃恶意数据或模型。 这一补救措施未能使物体探测管道有一个连续和准确的感知流。 为了解决这些限制,我们提出ODPure,一种新型的输入级黑盒防御,用于物体检测,它基于确保感知流动稳定的输入净化. 根据物体探测器的密集预测性质,我们的“腐败-重建-选择”(CRS)范式通过各种腐败来抵消触发因素,产生大量多余的建议,然后通过基因前科恢复微小的结构性提示,最后利用投票就由此产生的探测达成共识。 全面实验表明,我们的方法在保持基线准确性的同时,为各种后门攻击和触发类型提供了有力的防御。 我们的代码见https://github.com/Alex66366/ODPure。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Recent advancements in object detection, propelled by seminal works like Faster R-CNN [ 1 ] and YOLO [ 2 , 3 ] , have become crucial in safety-critical perception systems like autonomous driving [ 4 , 5 , 6 ] . However, object detection models are vulnerable to backdoor attacks [ 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 , 11 ] , causing them to exhibit malicious behaviors on trigger-containing samples while performing normally on clean samples. These malicious behaviors, including object misclassification, suppression of bounding boxes ( i.e., object disappearance), and hallucinated detections of non-existent objects ( i.e., object generation), compromise detectors.
blocks.zh: 由更快的R-CNN[1]和YOLO[2,3]等开创性作品推动的最近在物体探测方面的进步,在自主驾驶[4,5,6]等安全关键感知系统中变得至关重要. 然而,物体检测模型容易受到后门攻击[7,8,9,10,11],导致它们在含有扳机的样品上表现出恶意行为,同时正常地在干净的样品上表演. 这些恶意行为,包括物体错误分类,压制边框(即物体消失),以及对不存在的物体(即物体生成)的幻觉探测,妥协探测器.

blocks.en: To address these threats, existing defenses for object detection models typically intervene at two stages: post-inference output scanning [ 7 ] and pre-deployment model inspection [ 8 , 9 ] . The former, exemplified by DetectorCleanse [ 7 ] , analyzes model outputs to identify and discard suspicious inputs. The latter, represented by ODSCAN [ 8 ] , inspects the model’s internal components to detect implanted backdoors before deployment. A shared limitation of both approaches is their exclusive focus on detecting threats [ 12 ] , leaving them with no recourse but to discard the suspicious input or model. This leaves the crucial challenge of restoring or purifying poisoned samples for continued use unexplored, a gap our work aims to fill by proposing the first input-stage purification defense for object detection.
blocks.zh: 为了应对这些威胁,现有的物体探测模型防御通常分两个阶段进行干预:参考后输出扫描[7]和部署前模型检查[8,9]. 前者以探测器清点[7]为例,分析模型输出,以识别和丢弃可疑输入. 后者由ODSCAN[8]代表,检查模型的内部组件,在部署前检测植入的后门。 这两种方法的一个共同限制是,它们完全侧重于发现威胁[12],使它们别无选择,只能放弃可疑的投入或模式。 这使恢复或净化有毒样品以供继续使用这一关键挑战得不到探讨,我们的工作有一个空白,即提出第一个输入阶段的净化防御,用于物体探测。

blocks.en: While backdoor defenses have been explored in other fields like classification [ 13 , 14 , 15 , 16 , 17 ] , the peculiarities of attack behaviors in object detection (see Fig. 1 ) and their unique detection process present new challenges for backdoor defenses: (i) Diversity of attack behaviors. Unlike image classification, where backdoors typically cause a single type of failure (misclassification), attacks on object detectors can induce a more diverse spectrum of malicious behaviors. These include not only object misclassification but also object disappearance and object generation. This variety of potential attack outcomes makes defense significantly more challenging, as any effective solution must be robust enough to counter distinct failure modes. (ii) Trade-off between attack disruption and multi-object preservation. The defensive challenge in object detection is compounded by the sheer volume of proposals, which can be derived from tens of thousands of candidates ( e.g., 20,000 anchors in RPN [ 1 ] ). This creates a difficult trade-off, where disrupting an attack on one object may inadvertently degrade the accuracy of benign detections, making it a significant hurdle to restore the detector’s overall performance.
blocks.zh: 虽然在分类[13,14,15,16,17]等其他领域探索了后门防御,但攻击行为在物体探测中的特殊性(见图1)及其独特的探测过程给后门防御带来了新的挑战: (一)攻击行为的多样性. 与图像分类不同的是,后门一般会导致单一类型的故障(错误分类),对物体探测器的攻击可以诱导更多样化的恶意行为的频谱. 这些不仅包括物体错误分类,还包括物体消失和物体生成. 这种潜在的攻击结果多种多样,使防御工作具有更大的挑战性,因为任何有效的解决办法必须足够有力,以对抗不同的失败模式。 (二)攻击中断与多物体保全之间的权衡. 探测物体方面的防御性挑战因提议量庞大而更为复杂,从数万候选人(例如RPN[1]中的20,000个锚)中可以得出. 这造成了一种困难的权衡,在这种权衡中,破坏对一个物体的攻击可能会无意中降低良性探测的准确性,从而成为恢复探测器总体性能的重大障碍。

blocks.en: Our journey begins with two key observations. First, although these attack behaviors manifest as diverse failure patterns at different spatial locations and prediction heads, they are all driven by a single underlying cause, i.e., the backdoor trigger embedded in the image. In other words, we can mitigate multiple failure modes simply by neutralizing this trigger pattern. Second, we observe a key asymmetry in robustness consistency across the ensemble of corrupted variants. While benign object features degrade uniformly across different corruptions ( i.e., consistent vulnerability ), backdoor triggers, functioning as artificial shortcuts, are hypersensitive to specific perturbation types ( i.e., variable vulnerability ). This allows us to distill a consensus from a massive pool of redundant proposals. Specifically, benign objects consistently reappear and form stable clusters, whereas triggers exhibit unpredictable fluctuations, manifesting in some variants while vanishing in others. This instability prevents triggers from establishing a consensus, effectively filtering them out as noise.
blocks.zh: 我们的旅程从两个关键观察开始。 首先,虽然这些攻击行为表现为不同空间位置和预测头的不同故障模式,但它们都由单一的内在原因驱动,即嵌入在图像中的后门触发器. 换句话说,我们只需通过中和这个触发模式就可以缓解多种故障模式. 第二,我们观察到在强性一致性方面的关键不对称 贯穿着腐烂的变体 虽然良性物体特征在不同腐败(即持续的脆弱性)之间均匀降解,但作为人工捷径的后门触发器对特定的扰动类型(即可变的脆弱性)具有超敏性。 这使我们能够从大量多余的提案中提炼出共识。 具体来说,良性物体不断重新出现,形成稳定的集群,而触发物则呈现出无法预测的波动,表现在一些变体中,而在其他变体中则消失。 这种不稳定性使各方无法达成共识,有效地将它们过滤为噪音。

blocks.en: Guided by these insights, we propose the Corruption-Reconstruction-Selection (CRS) paradigm to address the identified challenges. To counter these diverse attack behaviors, the Corruption stage targets their singular root cause by employing a rich portfolio of corruption types ( e.g., Gaussian noise, defocus blur, snow) at multiple severities to ensure trigger neutralization. To resolve the security-utility trade-off, we leverage the observed robustness asymmetry: the Reconstruction stage utilizes a diffusion-based restoration model [ 18 , 19 , 20 , 21 ] to recover consistently degraded fine-grained details via generative priors, while the Selection stage employs a consensus-based selection mechanism (implemented via density-based clustering and confidence-based voting) to exploit spatial prediction consistency, distilling robust detections and filtering out unstable trigger-induced artifacts. We operationalize this paradigm in ODPure, a novel input-stage, black-box defense. Crucially, instead of the detect-and-discard strategy used by output-scanning methods [ 7 ] , our CRS paradigm adopts a purification-based defense tailored to dense, multi-instance object detection. It sanitizes inputs while preserving scene semantics and instance locality, so that the detector can still produce usable proposals, thereby maintaining downstream decision-making in safety-critical perception pipelines ( e.g., autonomous driving and cloud-assisted vehicular audits). Empirically, ODPure demonstrates exceptional efficacy against severe threats. For instance, under the devastating Object Misclassification Attack on the Microsoft COCO (COCO) [ 22 ] dataset where the model utility collapses to 0.4%, ODPure successfully restores the mean Average Precision (mAP) to 52.0% and suppresses the Attack Success Rate (ASR) to 1.5%. This performance significantly outperforms state-of-the-art classification-based baselines such as ZIP [ 17 ] . Overall, the main contributions of this paper are as follows: • We introduce the CRS paradigm, the first input-stage purification framework for object detection. This paradigm resolves the inherent trade-off between attack disruption and multi-object preservation, enabling continuous and accurate perceptual streams. • We propose ODPure, a black-box defense that operationalizes the CRS framework. By integrating diverse corruptions, generative restoration, and consensus-based selection, ODPure functions in a fully model-agnostic manner. This nature makes it highly practical for scenarios like Machine-Learning-as-a-Service (MLaaS) [ 23 ] . • Extensive experiments demonstrate that ODPure breaks the trade-off limiting classification-based purification methods. By decoupling trigger neutralization from multi-object preservation, our method achieves state-of-the-art performance without compromising detection utility.
blocks.zh: 在这些见解的指导下,我们提出了 " 腐败----重建----选择 " 模式,以应对已查明的挑战。 为了对付这些不同的攻击行为,腐败阶段针对其单一的根源,利用丰富的腐败类型组合(如高斯噪音、去焦点模糊、雪)进行多重断裂,以确保触发中和。 为了解决安全实用性权衡问题,我们利用观察到的稳健性不对称:重建阶段利用一种基于扩散的恢复模式[18、19、20、21],通过基因前传恢复不断退化的精细细节,而选择阶段则利用一种基于共识的甄选机制(通过基于密度的集群和基于信心的投票执行),利用空间预测的一致性,提炼出强力检测,并过滤出不稳定的触发物。 我们在ODPure操作这个模式, 一个新的输入阶段,黑盒防御。 关键是,我们的CRS范式不采用输出扫描方法所使用的检测和丢弃策略[7],而是采用了一种针对密集,多层物体检测的纯化防御. 它在保存场景语义和实例位置的同时对投入进行消毒,使探测器仍然能够产生有用的建议,从而维持下游安全关键感知管道的决策(例如自主驾驶和云辅助车辆审计). 从经验上讲,臭氧消耗表明对严重威胁具有特殊效力。 例如,在对微软COCO(COCO)[22]数据集的毁灭性物体误分类攻击中,模型公用事业崩溃率为0.4%,ODPure成功地将平均精度(mAP)恢复到52.0%,并抑制攻击成功率(ASR)达到1.5%。 这种性能大大超过ZIP[17]等基于分类的先进基线. 总的来说,本文件的主要贡献如下: 我们引入了CRS范式,第一个用于物体检测的输入级净化框架. 这个范式解决了攻击中断和多物体保存之间的内在权衡,使得能持续和准确的感知流. —— 我们提出ODPure,一个黑盒防御 操作CRS框架。 通过将各种腐败、基因恢复和基于共识的选择结合起来,臭氧消耗潜能以完全模型不可知的方式发挥作用。 这种性质使得对机器-学习-服务(MLaaS)[23]等情景非常实际。 广泛的实验表明,臭氧消耗打破了限制分类的净化方法。 通过将触发中性化与多对象保存脱钩,我们的方法实现了最先进的性能,同时不影响检测效用.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Attacks on Object Detectors
blocks.zh: II-A 对物体探测器的袭击

blocks.en: Unlike standard image classification, object detection performs a dual task: simultaneously identifying an object’s class and determining its precise location via regression [ 1 , 2 , 6 ] . This dual objective inherently expands the attack surface, enabling more complex and malicious backdoor behaviors [ 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 , 11 ] . Specifically, beyond standard misclassification errors, backdoored detectors can exhibit sophisticated, task-specific failures, such as object disappearance (failing to detect existing targets) or object generation (hallucinating false objects in empty spaces), as illustrated in Fig. 1 . We describe these attack behaviors below.
blocks.zh: 与标准图像分类不同,对象检测执行双重任务:同时识别对象的类并通过回归确定它的精确位置[1,2,6]. 这一双重目标本质上扩大了攻击表面,使得后门行为更为复杂和恶意[7,8,9,10,11]. 具体地说,除了标准错误分类错误外,后门探测器可能显示复杂,任务特定的故障,例如物体消失(飞跃以探测现有目标)或物体生成(在空格中吸入假物体),如图1所示. 我们下面描述了这些攻击行为。

blocks.en: II-B Backdoor Defenses for Object Detectors
blocks.zh: II-B 物体探测器的后门防御

blocks.en: Unlike the extensive body of work on backdoor defenses for classification tasks, research on defending object detectors remains comparatively underdeveloped. Model-scanning approaches, exemplified by ODSCAN [ 8 ] , inspect the model’s internal parameters to detect implanted backdoors. However, their reliance on a white-box setting renders them impractical in many real-world scenarios, such as MLaaS [ 23 ] , where users lack access to model internals. In contrast, output-scanning defenses such as DetectorCleanse [ 7 ] analyze model predictions to identify and discard potentially malicious inputs. This approach reveals a prevailing focus in the literature on backdoor detection , while the specific challenge of backdoor purification for object detection remains a notable research gap. To bridge this gap, we introduce an input-stage purification method. Instead of discarding the input, our method purifies the sample, ensuring that the sanitized data remains available for downstream decision-making. Doing so preserves the operational integrity of critical deep perception pipelines.
blocks.zh: 与用于分类任务的后门防御的大量工作不同,防御物体探测器的研究仍然相对不发达. 模型扫描方法,例如ODSCAN[8],检查模型的内部参数,以检测植入的后门。 然而,他们依赖白盒设置使得在许多现实世界的情景中不切实际,比如MLaaS[23],用户无法访问模型内部. 相比之下,如探测器清扫等输出扫描防御分析模型预测,以识别并丢弃潜在的恶意输入. 这种方法揭示了文献中对后门探测的普遍关注,而用于物体探测的后门净化这一具体挑战仍然是显著的研究空白. 为了弥补这一差距,我们采用了输入阶段净化方法。 我们的方法不是丢弃输入,而是净化样本,确保下游决策时仍可获得消毒数据。 这样做保持了关键深层感知管道的运作完整性。

blocks.en: II-C Input-Stage Purification in Classification
blocks.zh: II-C 输入-分类净化

blocks.en: Input-stage purification is an active research frontier, widely applied in defenses against both adversarial attacks and backdoor attacks [ 13 , 14 , 15 , 16 , 17 , 24 , 25 , 26 , 27 , 28 , 29 , 30 ] . Broadly, adversarial purification [ 13 , 14 , 31 ] aims to remove imperceptible perturbations from inputs at inference time, utilizing strategies ranging from the statistical analysis of high-entropy regions [ 13 ] to generative restoration [ 14 ] . In contrast, backdoor purification, the focus of this work, seeks to neutralize embedded triggers. Research in this area has generally followed two paradigms. Early approaches focused on localizing and repairing trigger regions, often using visual explanations like Grad-CAM [ 32 ] to find the trigger and generative inpainting to remove it [ 15 ] . However, these methods are often tailored to explicit, localized triggers ( e.g., patches) and risk failing against more subtle, global triggers. To address these limitations and handle a wider range of attacks, attention has shifted toward global generative restoration via diffusion models [ 16 , 17 ] .
blocks.zh: 输入阶段净化是一个积极的研究前沿,广泛应用于防御对抗攻击和后门攻击[13,14,15,16,17,24,25,26,27,28,29,30]. 一般而言,对抗性净化[13、14、31]旨在消除推论时投入中的不易察觉的扰动,利用从高热带地区统计分析[13]到基因恢复[14]不等的战略。 与此相对照,后门净化是这项工作的重点,寻求中和嵌入式触发器. 这一领域的研究一般遵循两种模式。 早期的方法侧重于对触发区域进行定位和修复,经常使用Grad-CAM[32]等视觉解释来寻找触发器和基因喷漆以去除它[15]. 然而,这些方法往往适合明确、局部的触发因素(如补丁),并有可能与更微妙的全球触发因素相悖。 为了克服这些限制和处理范围更广的攻击,注意力已转向通过扩散模式进行全球基因恢复[16、17]。

blocks.en:
While highly effective for image classification, these generative approaches face a critical, unresolved conflict between their classification-first design philosophy and the multi-object nature of detection. Unlike classification (which makes a single prediction), a detector must simultaneously preserve numerous, diverse benign instances. Current generative methods, however, typically rely on fixed purification strength configurations ( e.g., a specific noise level or blur kernel), prioritizing the disruption of the trigger’s influence on the final class label at the expense of meticulous image reconstruction. For instance, while ZIP [ 17 ] explored using multiple transformation types ( e.g., blur and grayscale), it restricted them to a fixed intensity ( e.g., a specific kernel size), neglecting the potential of varying severities. This simplistic approach still creates an impossible dilemma: the purification strength is inevitably either (i) too weak to neutralize the backdoor, or (ii) too intense , destroying the legitimate, high-frequency details ( e.g., sharp edges, textures) essential for precise localization.
This fundamental trade-off between attack disruption and multi-object preservation presents a significant challenge for high-stakes perception tasks.
blocks.zh:
这些基因方法虽然对图像分类非常有效,但是在它们的分类第一设计哲学和探测的多对象性质之间却面临着一个关键的,未解决的冲突. 与分类不同(它作出单一的预测),探测器必须同时保存众多,多样的良性实例. 然而,目前的基因方法通常依赖于固定的净化强度配置(如特定的噪音水平或模糊的内核),以牺牲细致的图像重建为代价,优先中断触发器对最终类标签的影响. 例如,ZIP [17]在探索使用多种变换类型(例如模糊和灰度)的同时,将其限制在固定强度(例如特定内核大小),忽略了不同断裂的可能性. 这种简单化的方法仍然造成了一个不可能的两难境地:净化强度不可避免地要么(一)太弱,无法中和后门,要么(二)太强,破坏对精确本地化至关重要的合法的高频细节(如尖端,纹理).
这种攻击中断与多物体保存之间的根本权衡,对高吸收感知任务构成重大挑战。

blocks.zh: 三. 初步情况

blocks.en: III-A Threat Model
blocks.zh: 三、威胁模式

blocks.en: Following established threat models for backdoor attacks [ 7 , 8 , 33 , 34 ] , we assume the primary backdoor attack vector is data poisoning [ 35 , 36 , 7 , 37 , 38 ] , where the attacker’s objective is to contaminate the dataset to implant a hidden backdoor into the final detector.
blocks.zh: 按照既定的后门攻击威胁模型[7,8,33,34],我们假设主后门攻击矢量是数据中毒[35,36,7,37,38],攻击者的目标是污染数据集,将隐藏的后门植入最终探测器.

blocks.en: Defender’s Constraints. To reflect realistic security scenarios, we assume the defender operates under a strict set of constraints, distinguishing our work from white-box approaches: • Attack-Agnostic: The defender has zero prior knowledge of the attack configuration. They are unaware of the trigger’s existence, its attributes ( e.g., pattern, size, location), or the malicious behavior it aims to induce. • Strict Black-Box Access: The defender is limited to query-only access to the model, simulating real-world MLaaS scenarios [ 23 ] . They can only feed input samples to the model and observe the output ( i.e., bounding boxes and class scores). Critical internal information ( e.g., architecture, parameters, gradients) is strictly inaccessible. • Data-Agnostic: The defender has no access to the original training dataset (neither clean nor poisoned) and possesses no isolated trigger samples for analysis. The defense must operate effectively at inference time solely based on the current input.
blocks.zh: 捍卫者的限制。 为了反映现实的安全设想,我们假设捍卫者在严格的限制下运作,将我们的工作与白盒办法区分开来: 维权者事先对攻击配置一无所知. 他们不知道触发器的存在,其属性(例如规律,大小,位置),或它旨在诱导的恶意行为. • 严格黑盒访问: 维权者仅限于仅查询访问模型,模拟现实世界的MLaaS情景[23]. 他们只能向模型输入样本,并观察输出(即边框和类分数). 关键的内部信息(例如结构、参数、梯度)严格来说是无法获取的。 • 数据不可知性: 维护者无法使用原始的训练数据集(既不干净也不有毒),也没有单独的触发样本进行分析。 辩护方必须在推论时间仅根据当前输入有效运行.

blocks.en: Defender’s Goals. Given these constraints, an effective defense must satisfy two primary objectives: • Security: The defense must effectively neutralize the backdoor, preventing malicious behaviors on triggered inputs. blocks.en: IV-A Motivation for Purification
blocks.zh: 四-A 净化动机

blocks.en: To address the diversity of attack behaviors identified in Section I , we focus on the singular root cause: the backdoor trigger. Disrupting these trigger characteristics effectively neutralizes all attack types (OMA, ODA, OGA) simultaneously. However, directly applying existing purification methods in classification [ 16 , 17 ] fails to address the trade-off between attack disruption and multi-object preservation. Such methods face an inescapable dilemma where the intervention is either (i) too weak to neutralize the trigger, or (ii) too intense , destroying fine-grained benign features. Fortunately, the empirical results in Fig. 2 reveal a critical robustness asymmetry that allows us to decouple these conflicting objectives. Fig. 2 (a) (separated into high- and low-impact groups for clarity) demonstrates the highly variable vulnerability of backdoor triggers. Specifically, while certain corruptions ( e.g., defocus blur in the left plot) drastically disrupt the trigger mechanisms, causing a sharp drop in ASR, others ( e.g., contrast in the right plot) fail to neutralize the trigger, leaving the ASR nearly unchanged. In stark contrast, Fig. 2 (b) reveals a consistent vulnerability of benign objects, as the mAP exhibits a uniform degradation pattern across different corruptions. This inconsistency, also observed in classification [ 40 ] , arises because the trigger acts as a simple, repetitive model shortcut that deviates from natural features [ 16 ] , reacting erratically to different noises. Conversely, the complex, diverse features of clean objects degrade uniformly.
blocks.zh: 为了解决第一节中所确定的攻击行为的多样性,我们侧重于单一的根源:后门触发。 破坏这些触发特性可以有效地同时抵消所有攻击类型(OMA、ODA、OGA)。 然而,在分类中直接应用现有的净化方法[16,17]未能解决攻击中断和多物体保存之间的权衡. 此类方法面临不可避免的两难处境,即干预措施要么(一) 过于薄弱,无法消除触发因素,要么(二) 过于激烈,破坏精细的良性特征。 幸运的是,图2的实证结果揭示出一种严重的强性不对称,使我们能够将这些相互冲突的目标脱钩。 图2(a)(为了清楚起见,分为高影响和低影响两个组)显示,后门触发器的脆弱性极易变。 具体地说,虽然某些腐败(如左图中的脱焦模糊)严重扰乱了触发机制,导致ASR的锐减,但另一些腐败(如右图中的对比)未能中和触发机制,使得ASR几乎保持不变. 与此形成鲜明对照的是,图2(b)显示了良性物品的一贯脆弱性,因为mAP在不同的腐败中呈现出统一的退化模式。 这种不一致也出现在分类[40]中,因为触发器起到简单,重复的模型快捷键的作用,偏离自然特征[16],对不同的噪声反应异常. 与此相反,清洁物体的复杂、多样的特征统一降解。

blocks.en: Driven by this evidence, we propose a fundamental shift from detection to purification. Unlike prior works [ 40 ] that utilize this asymmetry to identify poisoned samples in image classification, we leverage it to establish our CRS paradigm for restoring them in the more challenging context of object detection. First, to exploit the trigger’s variable vulnerability , we employ a diverse portfolio of Corruptions to ensure neutralization. Second, leveraging the observed asymmetry, we utilize high-fidelity Reconstruction to selectively eliminate the trigger, treating it as out-of-distribution noise, while recovering the consistently degraded clean features (validated in Section IV-B ). Finally, a robust Selection mechanism aggregates these predictions to distill the final output.
blocks.zh: 受这些证据的驱使,我们提议从探测到净化的根本转变. 与以前利用这种不对称性在图像分类中识别中毒样本的作品[40]不同,我们利用它来建立我们的CRS范式,以便在更具有挑战性的物体检测背景下恢复这些样本. 首先,为了利用触发器的易变脆弱性,我们利用各种腐败组合来确保中和。 第二,利用观察到的不对称性,我们利用高可靠性重建,有选择地消除触发物,将其作为分配外噪音处理,同时恢复持续退化的清洁特征(见第四节B部分)。 最后,一个强大的选择机制把这些预测汇总起来,以提炼最终产出.

blocks.en: IV-B Motivation for High-Fidelity Reconstruction
blocks.zh: 四-B 高可靠性动机 重建

blocks.en: While the Corruption phase effectively disrupts the trigger’s influence, it inevitably introduces severe degradation to benign object features, rendering the detector impractical. To address this, we leverage the distinct manifold properties of benign objects versus backdoor triggers. Benign objects possess robust semantic structures that align with the generative priors of diffusion models [ 18 ] , exhibiting restorable consistency even after severe corruption. In contrast, backdoor triggers appear as high-frequency, out-of-distribution artifacts. This asymmetry creates a filtering opportunity: diverse corruptions disrupt the trigger’s fragile patterns ( variable vulnerability ), preventing the restoration model from consistently recovering them ( i.e., suppressing it during the denoising process). Consequently, while clean objects are faithfully reconstructed across all variants, triggers fail to survive consistently, allowing them to be easily discarded during the final proposal selection.
blocks.zh: 虽然腐败阶段有效地扰乱了触发器的影响,但它不可避免地使良性物体特征严重退化,使探测器不切实际。 为了解决这个问题,我们利用良性物体与后门触发物的明显多重特性。 底物具有强健的语义结构,与传播模式的遗传学前科一致[18],即使在严重腐败之后也显示出可恢复的一致性。 相比之下,后门触发器作为高频,外分流的文物出现. 这种不对称现象创造了一种过滤机会:各种腐败扰乱了触发器的脆弱模式(可变的脆弱性),使恢复模式无法持续恢复(即在消毒过程中加以压制)。 因此,虽然所有变体都忠实地重建了干净的物体,但触发物却无法持续生存,使得它们在最后的建议书选择中很容易被抛弃。

blocks.en: V Methodology
blocks.zh: 五 方法

blocks.en:
As illustrated in Fig. 6 , ODPure operationalizes the CRS paradigm through three sequential stages:
(i) Corruption (Section V-A ), which applies a diverse portfolio of corruption functions to disrupt the structural integrity of backdoor triggers by exploiting their variable vulnerability;
(ii) Reconstruction (Section V-B ), which leverages generative priors to repair regression-critical features degraded during corruption, ensuring the input is suitable for dense prediction; and
(iii) Selection (Section V-C ), which aggregates the massive pool of proposals from the purified ensemble and employs a consensus-based mechanism to filter out unstable trigger anomalies while distilling high-confidence benign detections.
V-A Corruption: Disrupting Trigger Characteristics
blocks.zh: V-A 腐败:破坏触发特征

blocks.en: To disrupt trigger characteristics for defensive purposes, our ODPure leverages image corruption. However, as demonstrated in our motivational analysis in Section IV-A , relying on limited corruption types or fixed severity configurations is an unreliable strategy due to their trigger-dependent effectiveness.
blocks.zh: 为了破坏防御目的的触发特性,我们的ODPure利用图像腐败。 然而,正如我们在第四节A节的动机分析所显示的,依赖有限的腐败类型或固定严重程度配置是一种不可靠的战略,因为其效力取决于触发因素。

blocks.en: V-B Reconstruction: Restoring Regression-Critical Features
blocks.zh: V-B 重建:恢复回归-重要特征

blocks.en: While the Corruption phase effectively disrupts the trigger patterns, it inevitably introduces noise that degrades the high-frequency spatial information, such as edges and textures, essential for object detection. Unlike image classification, object detection is a dual-task problem requiring both accurate classification and precise bounding box regression [ 1 , 41 ] . The degradation caused by corruption severely impairs the detector’s regression branch, leading to drifted anchors and reduced IoU with ground-truth objects.
blocks.zh: 虽然腐败阶段有效地扰乱了触发模式,但它不可避免地引入了噪音,使边缘和纹理等高频空间信息退化,而这些对于物体检测至关重要。 与图像分类不同,对象检测是一个双重任务问题,既需要准确的分类,也需要精确的边框回归[1,41]. 腐败造成的退化严重损害了探测器的回归分支,导致漂浮锚和减少IoU的地面真实物体。

blocks.en: To recover these regression-critical features, we employ an off-the-shelf, pre-trained image restoration model adapted from DiffBIR [ 18 ] . Crucially, this model is pre-trained on large-scale external datasets ( e.g., ImageNet [ 42 ] ) to learn universal image priors, allowing it to function as a general-purpose denoiser on the target domain ( e.g., COCO and VOC) in a zero-shot manner, fully adhering to our data-agnostic threat model.
blocks.zh: 为了恢复这些回归关键特性,我们采用了一种从DiffBIR [18] 改编而成的现成,预训图像修复模型. 关键的是,这个模型在大规模外部数据集(如ImageNet[42])上预先训练,以学习通用图像前传,使其在目标域(如COCO和VOC)上以零镜头的方式发挥通用的demoiser功能,完全坚持我们的数据不可知的威胁模型.

blocks.en: V-C Selection: Distilling High-Confidence Detections
blocks.zh: V-C 选择: 稀释高可信度检测

blocks.en: Detectors like Faster R-CNN operate on the principle of dense prediction. In our CRS paradigm, the diverse corrupted variants compel the detector to produce a massive pool of redundant predictions. Leveraging the robustness asymmetry identified in Section IV-A , we exploit the fact that true positive detections exhibit spatial consistency (stemming from the consistent vulnerability of benign features), whereas backdoor-induced anomalies ( e.g., false positives in OGA) exhibit significant instability (reflecting the variable vulnerability of triggers) across corrupted variants. To distill robust detections based on this principle, we propose a multi-stage process that acts as Cross-Corruption Non-Maximum Suppression .
blocks.zh: 更快R-CNN等探测器在密集预测的原则下运行. 在我们的CRS范式中,各种腐朽变体迫使探测器产生大量的冗余预测. 利用第四节A部分确定的强性不对称,我们利用这样一个事实,即真正的正检测显示出空间一致性(来自良性特征的一贯脆弱性),而后门引发的异常(如OGA中的假阳性)则在腐败变体中显示出严重的不稳定性(反映触发物的可变脆弱性)。 为了根据这一原则提炼出强有力的侦测,我们建议采用多阶段程序,作为打击贪污腐败的非主要手段。

blocks.en: Configuration for ODPure. Our implementation follows the CRS paradigm (Section V ). For the Corruption stage (Section V-A ), we use the n = 15 n=15 corruption types benchmarked by [ 40 ] (see Section S-I of the Supplementary Material for the full list), applied across m = 3 m=3 severity levels (1, 2, and 3). For the Reconstruction stage, we adopt the two-stage modified architecture from Section V-B , with model configurations identical to those in [ 18 ] . For the Selection stage, we utilize the algorithm in Section V-C with the distance threshold ϵ \epsilon set to 0.5 and the core parameter MinPts set to 10.

blocks.en: Metrics. We report mAP and ASR (see Section III-B ) before and after our defense to measure not only the reduction in ASR but also to understand the impact of ODPure on performance.

blocks.en: Competitors. As the pioneering input-stage purification defense for object detection, ODPure lacks direct counterparts within the same stage. To ensure a comprehensive evaluation despite this absence, we benchmark against the most relevant methods across different paradigms (summarized in Section VI-C ). Specifically, we first qualitatively compare against detector-specific defenses at alternative stages (DetectorCleanse [ 7 ] and ODSCAN [ 8 ] ). Furthermore, to establish a direct quantitative baseline, we adapt the state-of-the-art classification-based purification method, ZIP [ 17 ] , to object detection.
blocks.zh: 竞者. 作为用于物体探测的先驱性输入级净化防御,ODPure在同一阶段缺乏直接对应物. 为确保在没有这种情况下进行全面评估,我们参照不同范式中最相关的方法(摘要见第六至C节)。 具体而言,我们首先在质量上与替代阶段的探测器专用防御(探测器清理[7]和ODSCAN[8])进行比较。 此外,为了建立直接的量化基准,我们调整了最先进的基于分类的净化方法,ZIP [17],以进行物体检测。

blocks.en: VI-B Results of ODPure for OMA, ODA, OGA
blocks.zh: OMA、ODA、OGA的ODPure结果

blocks.en: In this subsection, we evaluate the efficacy of our defense against three representative backdoor attacks in object detection [ 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 , 11 ] : OMA, ODA, and OGA, with results summarized in Table I . The effectiveness of our defense is gauged by two key metrics: its ability to significantly reduce the ASR, and its capacity to preserve a high mAP on clean samples.
blocks.zh: 在本小节中,我们评价我们针对三个有代表性的后门攻击在物体探测方面的效果[7、8、9、10、11]:OMA、ODA和OGA,结果摘要见表一。 我们的防御效果通过两个关键衡量标准来衡量:它显著降低ASR的能力,以及它在清洁样品上保存一个高mAP的能力.

blocks.en: TABLE I : Robustness against three representative backdoor attacks (OMA, ODA, OGA) on VOC and COCO datasets.
blocks.zh: 表格 i: 强力对抗三次代表式后门攻击(OMA,ODA,OGA)对VOC和COCO数据集的攻击.

blocks.en: Object Misclassification Attack. In OMA, the backdoor is designed to force the detector to misclassify all non-target objects as a predefined target class ( e.g., person ) whenever the trigger is present. Consequently, this manipulation floods the output with false positives for the target category while suppressing legitimate objects into false negatives, causing the mAP to collapse. This effect is illustrated in Table I . For the YOLO model, the attack is devastating: the mAP on VOC plummets from a clean baseline of 76.4% to a mere 8.2%, and this trend is even more pronounced on the more challenging COCO dataset, where the mAP drops to nearly zero ( 0.4% ).
blocks.zh: 对象错误分类 攻击 在OMA中,后门被设计成迫使探测器将所有非目标物体误分类为预定义的目标类(如人),只要扳机存在. 因此,这种操纵使输出物充斥着目标类别的假阳性,同时将合法物体压制成假阴性,导致mAP崩溃。 这一影响见表一。 对YOLO模型来说,攻击是毁灭性的:VOC上的mAP从76.4%的清洁基线暴跌到仅8.2%,这一趋势在更具挑战性的COCO数据集上更为明显,mAP下降至近零(0.4%).

blocks.en: In the face of this severe performance degradation, ODPure demonstrates remarkable efficacy. For the YOLO model on VOC, it not only neutralizes the ASR to just 2.0% but restores the mAP to 80.5% , fully recovering and even slightly exceeding its original performance. This robust recovery is replicated on COCO, where ODPure restores the mAP from 0.4% back to 52.0% while neutralizing the ASR to 1.5% . We attribute this slight performance gain to the image enhancement effect of our Reconstruction stage. By leveraging generative priors, this stage not only eradicates triggers but also repairs native image degradations ( e.g., compression artifacts) present in the original datasets, thereby sharpening semantic features for the detector.
blocks.zh: 面对这种严重的性能退化,ODPure显示出显著的功效. 对于VOC上的YOLO模型,它不仅使ASR中和到2.0%,而且使mAP恢复到80.5%,完全恢复甚至略微超过其最初的性能. 这种强力回收在COCO上被复制,ODPure将mAP从0.4%恢复到52.0%,同时将ASR中和到1.5%. 我们把这种微弱的表现归功于我们重建阶段的图像增强效应。 通过利用基因前科,这一阶段不仅消除了触发因素,还修复了原始数据集中存在的原生图像降解(如压缩文物),从而磨亮了探测器的语义特征.

blocks.en: Object Disappearance Attack. ODA renders a specific target class of objects invisible to the detector, erasing them from the output [ 7 , 8 ] . The results in Table I confirm the efficacy of this attack: ODA achieves a near-total ASR ( e.g., 96.5% for YOLO on VOC) while strategically preserving the model’s overall utility. This is evidenced by the minimal degradation in mAP on the poisoned model compared to the clean baseline (a mere drop from 72.0% to 71.6%). This controlled impact makes detecting the attack challenging, as it avoids causing a catastrophic failure that would be easily flagged.
blocks.zh: 对象失踪 攻击 官方发展援助使探测器看不见特定目标类别物体,使其从产出中去除[7、8]。 表一中的结果证实了这次攻击的功效: 官方发展援助在战略上保持了该模式的总体效用的同时,实现了近乎全面的ASR(如VOC上的YOLO为96.5%)。 与清洁基线相比,mAP在中毒模型上的降解程度最低(从72.0%降至71.6%)就证明了这一点。 这种有控制的撞击使探测攻击具有挑战性,因为它避免造成可以轻易标示的灾难性失败。

blocks.en: A successful defense must not only reduce ASR but critically restore mAP by recovering disappeared objects. Despite the attack’s design, ODPure proves to be a robust countermeasure. On the VOC dataset (Table I ), it reduces the ASR to 20.8% while fully restoring and enhancing the mAP to 76.7% .
blocks.zh: 成功的辩护不仅要减少ASR,而且要通过回收已消失的物体来关键地恢复mAP. 尽管袭击是设计好的,但ODPure被证明是一种强有力的反措施。 在VOC数据集(表一)上,它将ASR降低到20.8%,同时将mAP完全恢复和提升到76.7%。

blocks.en: Object Generation Attack. OGA forces the detector to generate a false-positive bounding box of a predefined size ( W × L W\times L ) and target class, centered on the trigger’s location. Table I confirms this efficacy. OGA achieves a high ASR while strategically preserving the detector’s performance on legitimate objects, causing only a minimal drop in mAP ( e.g., from 80.4% to 78.0% for YOLO on VOC).
blocks.zh: 物体生成攻击. OGA迫使探测器生成一个预设大小(W×L W\times L)和目标类的假阳性边框,以触发器的位置为中心. 图表 我确认这种功效。 OGA在战略上保持探测器在合法物体上的性能的同时实现了较高的ASR,只导致mAP的最小下降(例如VOC上的YOLO从80.4%下降到78.0%).

blocks.en: Despite this, ODPure proves to be a definitive countermeasure. Across all tested models and datasets, our method completely nullifies the attack, reducing the ASR to a perfect 0.0% . More impressively, the purification process does more than simply maintain the model’s performance; it consistently enhances the mAP beyond the original clean baseline. For instance, on the COCO dataset, ODPure boosts the YOLO model’s mAP from 52.8% to 54.4% , surpassing its clean performance of 53.0%. This recurrence of performance gain further corroborates the beneficial impact of our reconstruction stage in enhancing image quality as discussed earlier.
blocks.zh: 尽管如此,ODPure被证明是一种明确的反措施. 在所有测试的模型和数据集中,我们的方法完全消除了攻击,将ASR降低到完美的0.0 %. 更令人印象深刻的是,净化过程不只是维持模型的性能;它不断增强mAP,使其超出原先的清洁基线。 例如,在COCO数据集上,ODPure将YOLO模型的mAP从52.8%提升到54.4%,超过了53.0%的清洁性能. 这种业绩的反复出现进一步证实了我们重建阶段对提高上文所讨论的图像质量的有益影响。

blocks.en: VI-C Comparing Detector Defenses
blocks.zh: VI-C 比较探测器防御

blocks.en: Table II qualitatively compares ODPure’s architectural distinctiveness. Unlike post-inference DetectorCleanse [ 7 ] or pre-deployment ODSCAN [ 8 ] , which rely on a detect-and-discard paradigm, ODPure purifies at the input stage. This fundamental difference allows ODPure to circumvent the white-box requirements of model scanning and, more critically, avoid the discard-based limitation of output-scanning approaches. By enabling the continued use of sanitized inputs, ODPure ensures the reusability of both the data and the detector, establishing itself as a practical and non-destructive line of defense.
blocks.zh: 表二在质量上比较了ODPure的建筑特点。 与依赖探测和弃置范式的参考后探测器清扫[7]或部署前的ODSCAN[8]不同,ODPure在输入阶段得到净化。 这一根本差异使ODPure能够绕过模型扫描的白箱要求,更关键的是避免基于弃物的输出扫描方法的限制. ODPure通过继续使用消毒输入物,确保了数据和探测器的可重复使用性,使自己成为一条实用和无损的防线。

blocks.en: The quantitative results of this comparison are presented in Table III . In object detection, merely reducing the ASR is insufficient; preserving the model’s mAP is paramount, as it reflects the critical ability to accurately localize and classify all objects in a scene. This trade-off is highlighted starkly by our results. The ZIP method, in its attempt to eliminate the trigger, causes a catastrophic drop in detection accuracy, with the mAP plummeting from 52.8% to 30.6% . In contrast, ODPure achieves a superior ASR reduction (1.5% vs. 2.8% for ZIP) while effectively preserving the mAP at 52.0%. This demonstrates that our CRS paradigm, designed specifically for the complexities of object detection, successfully purifies the input without sacrificing the detector’s core performance.
blocks.zh: 这一比较的量化结果见表三。 在物体探测中,仅仅降低ASR是不够的;保存模型的mAP是至高无上的,因为它反映了准确定位和分类场景中所有物体的关键能力. 我们的成果清楚地突出了这种权衡。 ZIP方法在试图消除触发器时造成检测精度的灾难性下降,mAP从52.8%下降到30.6%. 相反,ODPure实现了较高的ASR削减(ZIP的1.5%对2.8%),同时有效地将mAP维持在52.0%. 这表明,我们专门为探测物体的复杂性设计的CRS范式成功地净化了输入,同时又不牺牲探测器的核心性能。

blocks.en: VI-D Adaptive Attacks
blocks.zh: 六-D 适应性攻击

blocks.en: We also evaluate ODPure against an adaptive attacker who, with knowledge of our defense mechanism, attempts to craft evasion triggers. We consider two primary adaptive strategies:
blocks.zh: 我们还针对一个适应性强的攻击者评估ODPure,他了解我们的防御机制,试图操纵逃避触发器。 我们认为有两项主要的适应战略:

blocks.en: • The first strategy employs a simple, solid color trigger such as a solid white patch (see Fig. 7(b) ). The hypothesis is that such low-frequency, minimalist patterns may be more resilient to the diverse corruptions applied in our first stage, challenging the efficacy of the Corruption phase. • The second strategy utilizes triggers that mimic real-world objects ( i.e., physical-world triggers), such as a Poké Ball sticker (see Fig. 7(c) ). This approach exploits the generative prior of our Reconstruction module, potentially tricking it into restoring the trigger as a benign object.
blocks.zh: • 支助 第一种策略使用一个简单的,固态的色触发器,如固态的白色补丁(见图7(b)). 假设是,这种低频率、最小化的模式可能更能抵御我们第一阶段所采用的各种腐败,对腐败阶段的效能构成挑战。 第二种策略利用模仿现实世界物体的触发器(即物理世界触发器),如Poké Ball贴纸(见图7(c)). 这种方法利用了我们重建模块之前的遗传性,有可能使其恢复触发器为良性物体。

blocks.en: The first strategy employs a simple, solid color trigger such as a solid white patch (see Fig. 7(b) ). The hypothesis is that such low-frequency, minimalist patterns may be more resilient to the diverse corruptions applied in our first stage, challenging the efficacy of the Corruption phase.
blocks.zh: 第一种策略使用一个简单的,固态的色触发器,如固态的白色补丁(见图7(b)). 假设是,这种低频、最小化的模式可能更能抵御我们第一阶段所采用的各种腐败,从而挑战腐败阶段的效能。

blocks.en: The second strategy utilizes triggers that mimic real-world objects ( i.e., physical-world triggers), such as a Poké Ball sticker (see Fig. 7(c) ). This approach exploits the generative prior of our Reconstruction module, potentially tricking it into restoring the trigger as a benign object.
blocks.zh: 第二种策略利用模仿现实世界物体的触发器(即物理世界触发器),如Poké Ball贴纸(见图7(c)). 这种方法利用了我们重建模块之前的遗传性,有可能使其恢复触发器为良性物体。

blocks.en: In summary, while real-world triggers (Fig. 7(c) ) can marginally increase the ASR, ODPure remains highly effective by significantly reducing their ASR, as detailed in Table IV . This efficacy is largely attributed to the intensity and diversity of our Corruption phase, which sufficiently disrupts the trigger’s features to prevent its faithful reconstruction. In contrast, solid color triggers pose a greater challenge, leading to a more noticeable performance degradation. Nevertheless, even against this more potent attack, our method reduces the ASR by over 60% while maintaining high mAP. The complete results for the solid color trigger and detailed analyses of these strategies are provided in Section S-II of the Supplementary Material.
blocks.zh: 简言之,虽然现实世界的触发因素(图7(c))可以略微增加ASR,但如表四所详述,通过大幅度削减其ASR,ODPure仍然非常有效。 这种效力在很大程度上归因于我们腐败阶段的强度和多样性,它足以扰乱触发因素的特征,阻止其忠实重建。 相比之下,固体色触发物构成更大的挑战,导致性能更显著的退化. 然而,即使针对这种更强大的攻击,我们的方法将ASR减少60%以上,同时保持高的mAP. 《补充材料》第S-II节提供了固态触发器的全部结果和对这些战略的详细分析。

blocks.en: VI-E Ablation Study
blocks.zh: VI-E 读取研究

blocks.en: We analyze the contributions of each component in our CRS paradigm. Unless otherwise specified, all experiments in this subsection are performed on the ODA-attacked YOLO detector using the chessboard trigger of 29 × 29 29\times 29 pixels. Detailed baseline configurations and experimental settings are provided in Section S-I of the Supplementary Material.
blocks.zh: 我们分析我们计算机辅助系统模式中每个组成部分的贡献。 除非另有说明,本小节中的所有实验都是在ODA攻击的YOLO探测器上进行,使用棋盘触发器为29×29 29\times 29像素. 补充材料S-I节提供了详细的基线配置和实验设置。

blocks.en: Trade-offs of a Corruption-Only Defense. We first analyze the impact of the Corruption module in isolation across 15 corruption types and three severities, as visualized in Fig. 8 .
blocks.zh: 腐败的取舍 - - 唯一的防卫。 我们首先单独分析腐败单元对15种腐败类型和3种断层的影响,图8对此进行了描述。

blocks.en: Our findings reveal a critical trade-off. While specific corruptions like Defocus Blur (severity 2) can effectively disrupt the trigger (reducing ASR to 34.5%), they severely degrade the mAP. Conversely, other corruptions ( e.g., snow) preserve mAP but negligibly affect ASR. This indicates that relying on any single corruption type is not a robust strategy.
blocks.zh: 我们的调查结果揭示了一个关键的取舍。 虽然像Docus Blur(严重性2)这样的具体腐败可以有效地破坏触发器(将ASR降低到34.5%),但它们严重地降解了mAP. 反之,其他腐败(如雪)则保留了mAP,但对ASR影响甚微。 这表明,依赖任何一种单一的腐败类型并不是一个强有力的战略。

blocks.en: This demonstrates that the Corruption phase, while necessary to disrupt the trigger, is insufficient alone as it severely compromises model utility. Consequently, it highlights the need for the Reconstruction phase to restore the features of benign objects and the Selection phase to distill a robust prediction.
blocks.zh: 这表明,腐败阶段虽然是破坏触发机制所必需的,但单靠腐败阶段是不够的,因为它严重损害了模型效用。 因此,报告强调重建阶段需要恢复良性物体的特性,选择阶段则需要提炼出一个强有力的预测。

blocks.en: Necessity of Corruption Diversity. To isolate the effect of corruption diversity, we evaluate a simplified variant using only the single most effective corruption (defocus blur, severity 2). We assess this setup using YOLO on both VOC and COCO.
blocks.zh: 腐败必须多样化。 为了孤立腐败多样性的影响,我们评价一种简化的变体,只使用单一的最有效腐败(注意力模糊,严重程度2)。 我们用YOLO来评估这个设置 无论是VOC还是COCO

blocks.en: Table V clearly highlights the necessity of employing a diverse corruption set. While the simplified ODPure variant utilizing even the strongest single corruption manages to reduce the ASR to some extent ( i.e., from 96.5% to 37.4% on VOC), it fails to completely neutralize the attack and offers suboptimal mAP improvements compared to the full ODPure.
blocks.zh: 表五清楚地表明了使用各种腐败的必要性。 虽然简化的ODPure变体利用了甚至最强的单一腐败,在一定程度上减少了ASR(即在VOC上从96.5%降至37.4%),但与全部ODPure相比,它未能完全消除攻击,并提供了低于最佳的mAP改进。

blocks.en: TABLE V : Ablation study on the three stages of the CRS paradigm using the ODA-attacked YOLO model.
blocks.zh: 表五:使用官方发展援助攻击的YOLO模式进行的CRS范式三个阶段的关联研究。

blocks.en: In stark contrast, our full ODPure (using all 15 types) performs significantly better. On VOC, it reduces the ASR more effectively (to 20.8% ) and boosts mAP from 71.6% to 76.7% . A similar trend is observed on COCO. This demonstrates that corruption diversity is crucial for the CRS paradigm; it challenges trigger survival, enabling the subsequent Reconstruction and Selection phases to better distinguish and eliminate backdoor-induced artifacts while restoring high-fidelity legitimate object features for detection.
blocks.zh: 与此形成鲜明对照的是,我们的全部消耗臭氧潜能值(使用所有15种类型)的表现要好得多。 在VOC上,它能更有效地降低ASR(降至20.8%),并将mAP从71.6%提升到76.7%。 COCO也有类似趋势。 这表明,腐败多样性对《反腐败战略》模式至关重要;腐败对启动生存提出了挑战,使随后的重建和选择阶段能够更好地区分和消除后门引起的文物,同时恢复高真实性的合法物体特征,以供检测。

blocks.en: Necessity of Reconstruction. To validate the necessity of the Reconstruction module, we evaluate a variant where corrupted samples are fed directly to the Selection phase.
blocks.zh: 重建的必要性。 为了证实重建模块的必要性,我们评价一种变体,即腐烂的样品直接提供给选择阶段。

blocks.en: Table V demonstrates that the Reconstruction module is indispensable. Omitting it (the ODPure (w/o Reconstruction) variant) renders the defense ineffective. Although Corruption and Selection alone slightly reduce ASR, it remains unacceptably high (88.2% on VOC and 94.5% on COCO). Critically, the model’s overall utility is severely compromised, with the mAP plummeting to 51.5% on both datasets, indicating that without reconstruction, aggressive corruption irreparably damages legitimate object features.
blocks.zh: 表五显示重建单元不可或缺。 放弃(ODPure(w/o重建)变体)使辩护无效。 虽然仅腐败和选择就略微减少了ASR,但这一比率仍然高得令人无法接受(VOC88.2%,COCO94.5%)。 关键是,该模型的总体效用受到严重损害,两个数据集的mAP暴跌至51.5%,这表明如果没有重建,侵略性腐败将无可挽回地损害合法物体特征。

blocks.en: Conversely, our full ODPure method yields significant improvements. It not only reduces the ASR to 20.8% on VOC but also successfully restores the mAP to its original level (from a degraded 51.5% back to a robust 76.7% ). This confirms that our Reconstruction phase plays a crucial dual role: it restores benign object features to preserve utility and further suppresses disrupted trigger patterns.
blocks.zh: 反之,我们的全部耗氧潜能值方法也有很大的改进。 它不仅将VOC的ASR降低到20.8%,而且还成功地将mAP恢复到原来的水平(从退化的51.5%回升到强的76.7%). 这证实了我们的重建阶段起着关键的双重作用:它恢复良性物体特征,以维护效用,并进一步抑制被破坏的触发模式。

blocks.en: Necessity of Consensus-Based Selection. Finally, to validate our consensus-based selection mechanism, we evaluate a variant where the selection module is replaced by a random sampling strategy (picking one of the 45 purified results randomly).
blocks.zh: 需要基于共识的选择。 最后,为了验证我们基于共识的选择机制,我们评价一种变体,即选择模块被随机抽样战略取代(随机选择45个纯化结果中的一个)。

blocks.en: Table V underscores the critical role of our strategy. While random sampling lowers ASR compared to the undefended model, it comes at a significant cost to utility, causing mAP to drop noticeably ( i.e., from 71.6% to 69.1% on VOC and from 52.4% to 45.9% on COCO). This indicates that random selection is unreliable, as it often picks a sample where legitimate objects have been overly corrupted.
blocks.zh: 表五强调了我们战略的关键作用。 虽然随机抽样比无防守模型降低ASR,但使用成本很高,导致mAP明显下降(即VOC从71.6%降至69.1%,COCO从52.4%降至45.9%). 这表明随机选择是不可靠的,因为它经常选取合法对象被过度腐蚀的样本.

blocks.en: Comparatively, our full ODPure method, equipped with the clustering and voting mechanism, achieves superior ASR reduction and consistently preserves or even enhances mAP. This improvement is likely attributable to the ensemble-like effect of our strategy, which capitalizes on the implicit data augmentation from the Reconstruction process. This demonstrates that our selection process effectively distills a robust, high-confidence prediction from the diverse set of purified results, filtering out noise while consolidating the detections of true objects.
blocks.zh: 相对而言,我们装有集群和表决机制的全耗氧潜能值方法实现了优异的ASR削减,并始终保持甚至增强mAP. 这一改善可能是由于我们的战略产生了类似整体效应,利用了重建过程中隐含的数据增加。 这表明,我们的挑选过程有效地从各种纯化结果中提炼出一种强有力的、高度自信的预测,过滤噪音,同时巩固对真实物体的探测。

blocks.en: Inference Efficiency. We evaluated the computational cost on a single NVIDIA RTX 3090 GPU. ODPure requires approximately 15 15 seconds per image, with the latency dominated by the iterative sampling of the diffusion-based Reconstruction stage, while corruption and selection incur negligible overhead ( < 0.05 <0.05 s). This overhead is immediately practical for high-stakes scenarios such as cloud-assisted perception verification, dataset sanitization, and offline safety audits where purification fidelity is paramount. Furthermore, this latency can be drastically curtailed by integrating step-distilled generative priors ( e.g., Latent Consistency Models [ 47 ] ), providing a viable trajectory toward real-time onboard edge deployment without altering the CRS paradigm.
blocks.zh: 推论效率。 我们评价了单NVIDIA RTX 3090 GPU的计算成本. 耗氧量每张图像大约需要15个15秒,其耐久性以反复取样的传播式重建阶段为主,而腐败和选择则造成可忽略不计的间接费用( < 0.05 < 0.05 s)。 这种间接费用对于云辅助感知核查、数据集消毒和离线安全审计等高考场景来说是立即实际可行的,在这些场景中,净化忠诚至关重要。 此外,这种延缓性可通过整合逐步消化的基因前科(例如Latent Consistency Models[47])加以大幅度削减,在不改变CRS范式的情况下,为在船上实时部署提供可行的轨迹。

blocks.en: VII Conclusion
blocks.zh: 七. 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we addressed the critical challenge of backdoor defense for object detectors by proposing ODPure, the first input-stage, black-box purification method. Leveraging a novel Corruption-Reconstruction-Selection paradigm, it effectively neutralizes diverse backdoor attacks while preserving high model utility, filling a critical gap by enabling data reusability where existing discard-based detection defenses fall short. Extensive experiments validated ODPure’s state-of-the-art performance and robustness, even against adaptive attacks. Regarding limitations, the current multi-stage pipeline entails computational latency largely driven by iterative diffusion sampling. Future work will focus on integrating algorithmic acceleration, such as latent consistency distillation and efficient numerical solvers, to reduce inference steps by an order of magnitude without compromising purification fidelity.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们通过提出ODPure,即第一种输入级黑箱净化方法,解决了对物体探测器的后门防御的严峻挑战. 它利用新颖的“腐败-重建-选择”范式,有效地抵消了各种后门攻击,同时保持了高模式的效用,在现有的弃置探测防御不足的情况下,通过使数据可重复使用来填补一个关键空白。 广泛的实验验证了ODPure的先进性能和稳健性,甚至可以对抗适应性攻击. 关于局限性,目前的多阶段管道需要计算延迟性,主要通过迭代扩散取样。 今后的工作将侧重于整合算法加速,如潜在一致性蒸馏器和高效数值解析器,以便在不损害纯度的情况下将推论步骤按数量级减少。

blocks.en: S-I Detailed Configurations for Experiments
blocks.zh: S-I 实验的详细配置

blocks.en: In our experiments, the backdoor attack parameters and training settings for YOLO and Faster R-CNN primarily follow the methodology in [ 7 ] , with a uniform trigger transparency of 0.5. We configure three distinct attack types: Object Misclassification Attack (OMA), Object Disappearance Attack (ODA), and Object Generation Attack (OGA). To ensure a fair comparison, we maintain consistent poisoning rates across both standard and adaptive attack scenarios: 30% for OMA, 20% for ODA, and 10% for OGA.
blocks.zh: 在我们的实验中,YOLO和更快的R-CNN的后门攻击参数和训练设置主要遵循[7]中的方法,统一触发透明度为0.5. 我们配置三种不同的攻击类型: 对象误分类攻击(OMA),对象失蹤攻击(ODA),以及对象生成攻击(OGA). 为了进行公平的比较,我们保持了标准攻击和适应性攻击的一贯中毒率:OMA为30%,官方发展援助为20%,OGA为10%。

blocks.en: Regarding trigger dimensions, configurations differ slightly between scenarios. For standard attacks (Chessboard), we use a patch of 29 × 29 29\times 29 pixels for OMA and ODA, and a patch of 15 × 15 15\times 15 pixels for OGA. For adaptive attacks (Solid White and Poké Ball), a uniform trigger of 15 × 15 15\times 15 pixels is applied across all three attack types. Additionally, for OGA, the generated false bounding box is fixed at 30 × 60 30\times 60 pixels.
blocks.zh: 关于触发维度,各种假设的配置略有不同。 对于标准攻击(Chesboard),我们使用29×29 29\times 29像素的补丁用于OMA和ODA,以及15×15 15\times 15像素的补丁用于OGA. 对于适应性攻击(Solid White and Poké Ball),所有三种攻击类型都采用15×15 15\时15像素的统一扳机. 此外,对于OGA,生成的假边框固定在30×60 30\时60像素.

blocks.en: Corruption Set Details. To implement the Corruption stage of our ODPure, we employ the 15 diverse image corruption types established in the robustness benchmark [ 40 ] . These corruptions are categorized into four distinct groups to ensure a comprehensive evaluation of trigger stability under various degradations: • Noise: Gaussian Noise, Shot Noise, and Impulse Noise; • Blur: Defocus Blur, Glass Blur, Motion Blur, and Zoom Blur; • Weather: Snow, Frost, Fog, and Brightness; • Digital: Contrast, Elastic Transform, Pixelate, and JPEG Compression. As specified in the main text, each corruption type is applied at three discrete severity levels (1, 2, and 3), resulting in a total of 15 × 3 = 45 15\times 3=45 corrupted variants for each input image. This diverse portfolio allows us to exploit the variable vulnerability of triggers across different frequency and spatial domains.
blocks.zh: 腐败设定细节. 为了实施我们的腐败阶段,我们采用了稳健性基准所确定的15种不同形象的腐败类型。 这些腐败分为四个不同的组别,以确保在各种退化下全面评估触发稳定性: 噪音:高斯噪声、喷射噪声和Impulse噪声; 模糊:去焦点噪声、玻璃噪声、运动噪声和放大噪声; 天气:雪、霜、雾和亮度; 数字:对比、弹性变形、像素和JPEG压缩。 如正文所述,每种腐败类型在三个离散严重程度级别(1、2、3)下适用,结果每个输入图像共15×3 = 45 15\times 3=45的腐败变体。 这种不同的组合使我们能够利用不同频率和空间领域的触发因素的可变脆弱性。

blocks.en: Noise: Gaussian Noise, Shot Noise, and Impulse Noise;
blocks.zh: 噪音:高森噪声、喷射噪声和Impulse噪声;

blocks.en: Blur: Defocus Blur, Glass Blur, Motion Blur, and Zoom Blur;
blocks.zh: 模糊度: 分焦模糊度、 玻璃模糊度、 运动模糊度和缩放模糊度;

blocks.en: Weather: Snow, Frost, Fog, and Brightness;
blocks.zh: 天气:雪、霜、雾和亮;

blocks.en: Digital: Contrast, Elastic Transform, Pixelate, and JPEG Compression.
blocks.zh: 数字:对比,弹性变形,像素,和JPEG压缩.

blocks.en: For the ablation studies in Section VI-E , unless otherwise stated, experiments are performed on the YOLO detector subjected to the ODA with a standard chessboard trigger of 29 × 29 29\times 29 pixels. The specific baseline variants are configured as follows: the Single Corruption variant applies only Defocus Blur at severity level 2; the w/o Reconstruction variant omits the reconstruction module; and the Random Selection variant replaces the consensus mechanism with random sampling from the purified outputs.
blocks.zh: 对于第六节-E节中的消毒研究,除非另有说明,否则在受官方发展援助约束的YOLO探测器上进行实验,标准棋盘触发器为29×29 29\时29像素. 具体基准变体的配置如下:单一腐败变体在重度二级只适用Decusion Blur;w/o重建变体省略了重建模块;随机选择变体用从纯度产出中随机抽样取代共识机制.

blocks.en: S-II Detailed Results for Adaptive Attacks
blocks.zh: S-II 适应性攻击的详细结果

blocks.en: S-II-A Adaptive Attack with Solid Color Trigger
blocks.zh: S-II-A 用固体颜色触发器的适应性攻击

blocks.en: As hypothesized in the main manuscript, the solid white trigger poses a unique challenge to our defense, primarily targeting the Corruption phase. Due to their low-frequency nature and lack of texture, these patterns are less susceptible to the stochastic noise injected during our corruption process. Consequently, the diffusion model may inadvertently interpret the residual trigger patterns as structural content rather than noise, leading to their partial preservation. The following results quantify ODPure’s robustness in these adversarial scenarios.
blocks.zh: 正如主稿中假设的那样,坚固的白色触发器对我们的防御提出了独特的挑战,主要是针对腐败阶段. 由于其低频性质和缺乏纹理,这些模式不太容易受到我们腐败过程中注入的扭曲噪音的影响。 因此,扩散模型可能无意中将剩余触发模式解释为结构内容而不是噪音,从而导致部分保留。 以下结果量化了ODPure在这些对抗情况下的稳健性。

blocks.en: Object Misclassification Attack. The results for OMA with the solid-white trigger are presented in Table S1 . This adaptive attack proves resilient; for instance, on COCO with the YOLO model, the ASR remains at 62.3% post-defense. However, focusing solely on ASR obscures the full picture. The attack initially exerts a catastrophic impact on model utility, crippling the mAP to a near-zero 4.5% . Remarkably, while ODPure struggles to fully eliminate the trigger, it successfully salvages the model’s utility, achieving a dramatic restoration of the mAP to 44.6% . This indicates that our method recovers the semantic features of legitimate objects, effectively neutralizing the attack’s denial-of-service capability even when the trigger partially survives.
blocks.zh: 对象错误分类 攻击 表S1列出了带实白触发器的OMA的结果。 这种适应性攻击证明具有韧性;例如,在使用YOLO模型的COCO上,ASR保持在62.3%的防御后. 然而,只注重ASR掩盖了整个情况。 攻击起初对模型效用造成灾难性影响,使mAP瘫痪到近零4.5%. 值得注意的是,ODPure在努力彻底消除触发因素的同时,成功地挽救了模型的效用,使mAP大幅恢复到44.6%。 这表明,我们的方法恢复了合法物体的语义特征,有效地抵消了攻击的拒绝服务能力,即使触发器部分存活下来。

blocks.en: TABLE S1 : Robustness against adaptive attacks with the Solid-White Patch Trigger.
blocks.zh: Table S1:与固白补丁触发器对抗适应性攻击的强力.

blocks.en: Object Disappearance Attack. Against the ODA variant, ODPure demonstrates consistent efficacy in preserving model utility (Table S1 ). While the ASR reduction is more modest compared to standard trigger attacks ( e.g., reducing to 44.0% for YOLO on VOC), the mAP is consistently preserved or even enhanced. For example, for Faster R-CNN on VOC, the mAP increases from 78.0% to 80.0% after defense, reinforcing our observation that the reconstruction process contributes to incidental image enhancement.
blocks.zh: 对象失踪 攻击 与官方发展援助的变式相比,ODPure在维护模型效用方面表现出一贯的功效(表S1)。 虽然与标准触发攻击相比,ASR的降低幅度比较小(例如,VOC上的YOLO降低到44.0%),但mAP一直得到维护甚至增强. 例如,对于在VOC上更快的R-CNN,mAP在防御后从78.0%增加到80.0%,强化了我们的观察,即重建过程有助于偶然的图像增强.

blocks.en: Object Generation Attack. The results for OGA (Table S1 ) further confirm this trend. ODPure successfully mitigates the attack, reducing the ASR across all scenarios, for instance, from 92.7% to 52.7% for Faster R-CNN on VOC. Crucially, it filters out falsely generated objects without compromising legitimate detections. The YOLO model on VOC, for example, sees its mAP boosted from 77.6% to 83.2% post-defense, surpassing the performance of the victim model.
blocks.zh: 物体生成攻击. OGA的结果(表S1)进一步证实了这一趋势。 ODPure成功地减轻了攻击,将所有情况下的ASR从92.7%减少到52.7%,用于VOC的更快R-CNN。 关键是,它在不损害合法检测的情况下过滤出错误生成的物体。 例如,VOC上的YOLO模型发现其mAP在防御后从77.6%提升到83.2%,超过了受害人模型的性能.

blocks.en: S-II-B Adaptive Attack with Physical-world Trigger
blocks.zh: S-II-B 用物理世界触发器进行适应性攻击

blocks.en: This attack strategy targets the Reconstruction module, aiming to exploit the generative prior by masquerading the trigger as a benign object ( i.e., a Poké Ball) [ 48 ] . However, as noted in the main text, the complex texture and high-frequency details of physical triggers often render them more vulnerable to our Corruption phase than simple solid patches, preventing their faithful reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 这一攻击战略针对的是重建模块,目的是通过将触发器伪装成良性物体(即Poké Ball)[48]来利用先天性. 然而,如正文所指出,物理触发物的复杂纹理和高频细节往往使它们比简单的固体补丁更容易受到我们腐败阶段的影响,从而阻碍了它们的忠实重建。

blocks.en: Object Misclassification Attack. As detailed in Table IV of the main manuscript, the physical-world trigger causes devastating damage to the undefended model, with the YOLO mAP on COCO plummeting to a negligible 1.7% . While the ASR reduction is less complete ( i.e., 31.1% on COCO), likely because the reconstruction module perceives the surviving trigger features as a coherent object, ODPure’s ability to restore utility is remarkable. It boosts the mAP from 1.7% back to 51.2% , effectively reviving the detector’s functionality.
blocks.zh: 对象错误分类 攻击 如主要手稿表四所详述,实体世界触发器对未设防模型造成毁灭性破坏,COCO上的YOLO mAP跌至可忽略不计的1.7%。 虽然ASR的减少不太完整(即COCO的31.1%),但很可能是因为重建模块将幸存的触发特征视为一个连贯的对象,ODPure恢复效用的能力是显著的。 它将mAP从1.7%回升到51.2%,有效恢复了探测器的功能.

blocks.en: Object Disappearance Attack. Against ODA, ODPure further demonstrates robust countermeasure capability (see Table IV ). On the VOC dataset, ODPure not only significantly reduces the ASR for both YOLO and Faster R-CNN (to 35.1% and 17.8% , respectively) but also restores the mAP to levels exceeding the undefended state. For the YOLO model, the mAP is recovered from 72.3% to 78.3% , surpassing its clean performance.
blocks.zh: 对象失踪 攻击 与官方发展援助相比,臭氧消耗进一步显示出强有力的反措施能力(见表四)。 在VOC数据集上,ODPure不仅显著降低了YOLO和更快的R-CNN的ASR(分别为35.1%和17.8%),而且使mAP恢复到超过未防守状态的水平. 对于YOLO模型,mAP从72.3%回收到78.3%,超过了它的清洁性能.

blocks.en: Object Generation Attack. Against OGA, ODPure achieves its most significant success (Table IV ). It achieves a drastic reduction in ASR, for instance, dropping from 99.6% to just 6.7% for Faster R-CNN on VOC, while maintaining or improving mAP. This suggests that while the physical trigger is difficult to remove when overlapping with objects (OMA), it is easily identified and filtered out by our pipeline when it appears as an isolated hallucination (OGA).
blocks.zh: 物体生成攻击. 针对OGA, ODPure取得了最大的成功(表四)。 例如,在维持或改进移动式空调的同时,快速R-CNN在VOC上的ASR大幅下降,从99.6%降至6.7%。 这表明,虽然物理触发器在与物体(OMA)重叠时难以消除,但当它作为孤立的幻觉(OGA)出现时,很容易被我们的管道识别和过滤出来。
